title: Sky Blue: Preparing Investor Reports
summary: “Sky Blue: Preparing Investor Reports” explains how to build an investor packet using included investor-ready reporting tools and burn-rate analytics (integrated with reporting). It covers selecting a reporting period, including exhibits (cash position, operating inflows/outflows, burn summary, runway overview), adding narrative for variances/one-time items, and workflow steps like locking the dataset before export and storing versioned copies for audit consistency.
faqs: Which investor-ready reporting tools are included in Sky Blue for investor packets?
How do I choose the reporting period and what exhibits should I include?
What narrative context should I add for material variances and one-time items?
What should I do before exporting to avoid late changes to the report?
What notes should be attached to the packet (e.g., accounting treatments, vendor changes, hiring plans)?
How should I store exports to ensure audit consistency?
